name: testing-net
description: The .NET realization of the testing principles: xUnit v3 on Microsoft.Testing.Platform, test project layout and shared props, InternalsVisibleTo, naming, TestContext cancellation (xUnit1051), Testcontainers fixtures built from the repo's own scripts, test-data helpers, the clock, the host composition test, WebApplicationFactory host tests with hand-written fakes, and running the suites.
